entries.title: This week at Linden Loaf
entries.body:
# This week at Linden Loaf

*Bakes Wed – Sun · 7am – 2pm · 14 Mill Lane*

## Daily breads

| Loaf | Size | Price | Allergens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Country sourdough | small / large | $5 / $8.50 | wheat |
| Whole wheat | large | $7.00 | wheat |
| Rye | sliced | $7.50 | rye, wheat |
| Brioche | loaf | $9.00 | wheat, egg, dairy |

## This weekend's specials

- **Cardamom morning buns** · Saturday only, 24 per bake
- **Olive fougasse** · Sunday only, paired with Hawthorn olive oil
- **Seeded country loaf** · Saturday only, sunflower + poppy crust

## Today's bake schedule

| Time | Batch |
|---|---|
| 05:30 | Sourdough country (1st bake) |
| 07:00 | Cardamom morning buns |
| 09:00 | Brioche loaves + burger buns |
| 11:00 | Rye + whole wheat |
| 13:00 | Sourdough country (2nd bake) |

> Pre-orders close **Friday 6pm** for weekend pickup.
> Email `orders@lindenloaf.test` or call 555-0118.
